entries.community_name: ARADIA INC MARIE CURIE TASK FORCE
entries.description: Inactive group hoping to revive, interested in womyn's land. Members own land as individuals and severals. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women. Group is 95% lesbians and 5% non-lesbians.
entries.raw_text: ARADIA INC MARIE CURIE TASK FORCE PO Box 7516, Grand Rapids, MI 49507. We are interested in, among other things, womyn's land. As individuals and severals we own land. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women (womyn born only), dogs sometimes. We are: 95% lesbians, 5% nonlesbians, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type: members own land "As individuals and severals" with no group residence described and the group is "inactive", so coded Private/Individual Land (individual ownership); could alternatively be Land Fund. Land state set to MI from the mailing address, which is a PO box, so no land street, city or zip. Accepted groups: "girl and boy children" = Girl children + Boy children; "nonlesbian women (womyn born only)" = Non-lesbian women; Lesbian women added because the directory is for lesbians. Dogs are not a coded group. No residents or acreage given.

Not a listing: organization running backpacking trips with no land of its own ("It is a backpacking experience"). Per codebook, groups that only run trips are not rows. Excluded; emitted as a not_a_listing placeholder with no raw text.

entries.description: Lesbian-oriented group within the large mixed Twin Oaks community of women and men in Louisa, VA, on 400 acres with residences, shops, woods and farm land. Looking for more lesbians; welcomes members, children (maybe), lesbians, non-lesbian women and males. Works against sexism, heterosexism, racism, ageism and competition. No pets, no drugs.
entries.raw_text: OAKYNWOMYN Twin Oaks Community, Louisa, VA 23093. We are a large community of women and men looking for more lesbians and wimmyn-oriented-wimmyn. By our behavior we strive to eliminate the attitudes and results of sexism, heterosexism, racism, ageism and competition. Bring no pets. NO DRUGS! We welcome: new members/residents, children (maybe), lesbians, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 65 nonlesbians, 400 acres, housing/permanent structures (residences, shops, garage, etc), plumbing/electricity, camping space (visitors have rooms), woods, farm land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND. Editor's note above: "The following two are not women's land groups, but they do welcome lesbians as visitors or members." Type: "a large community of women and men" = Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land: mailing address is a community address (Twin Oaks Community, Louisa), treated as the land. Residents: 4 lesbians + 65 nonlesbians = 69, who live there as members of the community ("visitors have rooms" are separate). Accepted: "children (maybe)" = Girl + Boy children; "males" = Gay men + Non-gay men; "nonlesbian women" named. Focus: "NO DRUGS!" = Recovery/substance-free; Farming not coded, "farm land" is only a checklist item, so removed here? Kept only substance-free as rule. [Correction: Farming/self-sufficiency listed in focuses but rests only on checklist item "farm land"; should be treated as not coded.]

entries.description: Pacifist musical craftspeople in a simple lifestyle on 7 acres in Sparta, TN, promoting spiritual power and androgynous philosophy. Short visits welcome with advance notice. No TV, pets supervised, no hard drugs. Welcomes children, lesbians, non-lesbian women and males.
entries.raw_text: FAR AWAY FARM Rt 7 Box 279, Sparta, TN 38583 (615)277-3854. Pacifist musical craftspeople in simple lifestyle promoting spiritual power and androgynous philosophy. Short visits welcome with advance notice. No TV. Pets under strict supervision only. No hard drugs, others with our knowledge. We welcome: children, lesbians, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have: 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND. Editor's note above: "The following two are not women's land groups, but they do welcome lesbians as visitors or members." Type: a group of "craftspeople in simple lifestyle" living on the land, number unknown, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land: rural route address is the land. Accepted: "children" = Girl + Boy; "males" = Gay men + Non-gay men; "nonlesbian women" named. Focuses: "spiritual power" = Spirituality/ritual; "musical craftspeople" = Archives/cultural work; "No hard drugs" = Recovery/substance-free (a stated rule). Residents not stated.
